title: Warm Flaky Tunisian Jasmine Rice Pilaf
description: A flavorful and aromatic solo dinner dish featuring jasmine rice, stir-fry, and umami flavors, inspired by Tunisian cuisine, vegetarian-friendly.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add sliced mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add rinsed jasmine rice and cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is coated with oil and slightly toasted.
Add vegetable broth, dried thyme, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked.
Remove from heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve warm.
